title: Your procedure is denied: fail-closed verification of model-drafted claim-denial appeals against the clinical record, a 50-case synthetic benchmark of three Meta models
description: A physician's response to a payer's claim denial, drafted by a Meta model from the chart and held to the record by a deterministic gate reimplemented from the LITMUS papers. Fifty synthetic denials with a grading key, three models in three modes, nine kept runs and eight repeats, a 9,475-fabrication spike-in that measures the gate's sensitivity, and, post hoc, the gate pointed at the insurer's own determination, a repair turn on blocked drafts, an effort sweep, the fifty denials as remittance letter images read back by a model, and a dictation pipeline. No real patient data. Built during the Meta Global AI Developer Hackathon, October 26 to November 4, 2026. The README is the manuscript; the result files, the gate, the harness, and the viewer are in /build.
notes: Code is Apache-2.0; written content and figures are CC BY 4.0 (LICENSE-CONTENT.md). All data are synthetic.
